items.title: Costco Stock Sets Up Amid Medicare Advantage News
items.summary: Costco stock reclaimed a key technical level on Tuesday as the warehouse club climbed amid news of a partnership to offer Medicare Advantage plans to members.  Costco Wholesale will offer co-branded plans in partnership with nonprofit health insurer Scan Group.  Scan, based in Long Beach, Calif., has about 560,000 Medicare Advantage members in Southern California, Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico and Texas, according to the Wall Street Journal.
